$comment: Who writes code. routing.builder: claude | codex | auto. 'claude' sends the build kinds (prepare, takeover, design, fix, ci-heal) to Claude and drops the codex rungs from the repair chain; 'codex' is the pre-R477 behaviour; 'auto' routes build kinds by routing.capacity scores (spare capacity that would otherwise expire; unknown usage is excluded; see docs/agent/architecture.md). When every capacity reader is unknown, auto falls back to the threshold: Codex until the newest reading reaches autoClaudeAbovePercent (90, raised from 70 on 2026-11-19 because Codex has the most spare quota), then Claude (unknown reading goes to claude). codexReserveForAudit keeps Codex for audits and review seats only: it is never held by this setting. auditProvider names the canonical audit provider. Cascade: platform < repo < env WE_ROUTING_BUILDER, so a platform-file override cannot beat this repo file. New-session AI routing uses one providerOrder (codex/claude, distinct, maximum two), cascaded standard < platform < tool < WE_ROUTING_PROVIDER_ORDER (JSON array). Explicit legacy aiRouting role pins take precedence; resumed identities are preserved. Invalid orders refuse new sessions with an operator recovery diagnostic. Override-only launch callers retain their evidence/tier policy until migrated to session:true. Helper uses Luna/Haiku; preparation retains Astra/Sonnet; review and judge exclude small models.
